remake: 1 Pumpkin Ale, 1 friend, 1 long walk home. Serves 2.

1. Clean the Blockmaker when you are done.
2. The Fuelmaker is not a snack machine.
3. Whoever taught the Woodworker to hum: thank you. It is much happier now.
A note you take goes into your pack. You can pin it back any time.
Answers to Mr. Snoot. Last seen eating a doormat on floor 3. If found, please do not give him any more doormats. Reward: one slightly used Cherry.
Before filling out this form, please fill out Form 27-B Stroke 5, which explains how to fill out this form. Thank you for your patience. Your patience has been filed.
Blockmaker: Mon, Wed, Fri. Woodworker: whenever it is in the mood.
Brave visitors for a tour of the upper rooms. Lanterns provided. Courage not included.
Found something? Pin a note saying where you left it.
Hats in the lobby box. Please return the tall one, it has a career.
Have something to spare? Say what it is and where to find it.
I built one door too many and then kept going. Some of them go somewhere.
I came up the stairs on Tuesday. It is Friday now. The view is lovely. Please send snacks.
I had more emblems than shelf space. The Giants won't mind. Probably.
I left a few tunes behind. Shake one when it gets too quiet.
If you are reading this, you made it to uutiif. Welcome to the best junk drawer in Ur.
If you borrowed my trowel, I'm not angry. I'm just disappointed. And also slightly angry.
In through the nose. Out through the ears, if you can manage it. Most of us can't, but it is nice to try.
It has a little chip in the handle and a lot of sentimental value.
It is Thursday, actually. Snacks are on the way. Do not eat the dust bunnies, they are friends.
It was a good game. Pet a Piggy for me.
Leave something, take something. Last week somebody left a whole Cubimal. We are still talking about it.
Left my spare Spinach here. You look like you could use a hop.
Monday: water the gardens. Tuesday: water the gardens again, because Monday forgot. Wednesday onward: see Monday.
New in the Towers? Knock on any door. Somebody will have tea, or at least hot water and good intentions.
Okay, you can take the last Bean.
One monocle, one glove, one very small hat. If they are yours, you are probably a very small butler.
Opening night! Applause is free. Encores are also free, but please pace yourselves.
Please keep Musicblocks below a gentle jangle after dark.
Please keep notices friendly.
Please stop polishing the stairs. They are already very slippery and very proud.
Please stop rearranging the portraits. They do it on their own, and they find it very confusing when you help.
Potluck on the roof this Saturday. Bring a dish. Bring a chair. Do not bring the Rook.
Purple Flowers, Fiber, a Firefly Jar with nobody in it. All yours.
Remember where you parked your Cubimal.
Spare seeds in the jar by the door. Take a handful, grow a mouthful.
That is not a complaint. It is a compliment to whoever is growing them.
The Manor is not haunted. The Manor is just old and a little dramatic. Please wipe your feet anyway.
The Metal Machine has been tuned. It now goes clunk instead of clonk.
The Towers' players seek a Piggy to play a Piggy. Method actors welcome.
The lift is out of order (we never had a lift). The stairs are in excellent order. Mind the third step, it likes to be noticed.
The machines here are for everyone. Please leave them ready for the next visitor.
These keys open nothing I know of. Maybe they open something you know of.
This bag is bigger. I checked.
This board holds ten notes. Take one down to make room for yours.
To everyone who ever squeezed a Chicken with me: thank you. It was always worth the feathers.
To the kind Glitch who oiled the Woodworker: it hums now.
To whoever oiled the Woodworker: it hums now.
Tower dues are one smile per week, payable to the nearest neighbour.
We are low on fuel cells again. Please make two if you use one.
